fields.EN:
A gun that fires Jack's blood as bullets.
His blood can purge the girls' Corruption.
fields.JP:
ジャックの血を弾として射つ
ことができる銃。血には少女
達の穢れを払う力がある。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoots Jack's
blood to purify
the Maidens.

fields.EN:
Creates a mysterious hole. Entering it lets
you escape the dungeon.
fields.JP:
不思議な穴を作り出す能力。
作り出した穴に入ると
ダンジョンから脱出できる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Escape dungeons
by going down
the hole.

fields.EN:
Uses giant scissors to cut through obstacles
directly ahead.
fields.JP:
巨大なハサミで目の前の
障害物を切り裂く能力。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Giant scissors
to sever any
obstructions.

fields.EN:
Shrinks items. Changing their size can also
change how they can be used.
fields.JP:
アイテムを小さくすることが
出来る能力。大きさを変える
ことで使い道も変えられる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shrink items
to alter their
use.

fields.EN:
Places a poisonous bomb. Its blast hits the
surrounding area and inflicts powerful poison.
fields.JP:
毒性の爆弾を設置する能力。
周囲に爆発の衝撃と
強力な毒の影響を与える。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Venomous bombs
to affect the
immediate area.

fields.EN:
Fires thorn arrows forward, striking anything
they come into contact with.
fields.JP:
茨の矢を放つ能力。
前方に向かって放った矢は
接触した物に衝撃を与える。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thorn arrows
that make a
huge impact.

fields.EN:
Warps to where bread crumbs were dropped,
letting you reach places you cannot walk to.
fields.JP:
パンくずが落ちた地点にワー
プする能力。歩いていくこと
ができない場所へ移動できる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Warp to where
bread crumbs
are left.

fields.EN:
Uses long hair to catch items. It works on
treasure chests, gathering spots, and other
suspicious places.
fields.JP:
長い髪でアイテムをキャッチ
できる能力。宝箱や採取地点
など怪しい所に使用可能。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Grow hair to
reach distant
items.

fields.EN:
Enhances the body for super-speed movement
in dungeons. The effect lasts 12 seconds.
fields.JP:
超スピードでダンジョン内を
移動できる身体強化能力。
１２秒間の時間制限がある。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A 12-second
boost to speed
in the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Uses bamboo's blessing to create a powerful
barrier nearby that protects against traps.
fields.JP:
竹の加護によって周囲に強力
なバリアを作る能力。罠から
身を護ることができる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A mighty shield
to protect
against traps.

fields.EN:
Plays a special flute to create magnetism,
pulling various objects toward the flute.
fields.JP:
特殊な笛を吹くことで磁力を
生み出す能力。笛に向かって
様々な物が引き寄せられる。

fields.EN:
Creates a spherical object. Drop it into
certain pits to make them passable.
fields.JP:
球状の物体を生成する能力。
特定の落とし穴に落とすと、
通ることができる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Create an orb.
Drop it in holes
to get through.

fields.EN:
Creates ice to cool hot objects or freeze
certain things.
fields.JP:
氷を生成する能力。
熱いものを冷やしたり、
特定のものを凍らせる。

fields.EN:
The protagonist. Imprisoned in the Jail with Alice,
he was rescued by Akazukin. Though somewhat timid,
he has a strong core. To aid the Blood Maidens who
fight each day, he supports them in their attempt
to escape the Jail.
fields.JP:
本作の主人公。
ジェイルの収容者としてアリスと共に
囚われていたが赤ずきんに助けられる。
少し気弱ながらも芯の強い側面を持ち、
日々戦う血式少女隊の力になる為、
少女たちのサポートとして脱獄に挑む。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The main character.
Despite being timid,
he has a strong
heart, and assists
the Blood Maidens
in finding a way
out of the Jail.

fields.EN:
Jack's childhood friend. Serious and level-headed,
she can become emotional when it comes to Jack.
After learning she is a Blood Maiden, she decides
to join the unit so she can escape the Jail with him.
fields.JP:
ジャックと幼馴染の少女。
物事を冷静に見る真面目な性格だが、
幼馴染のジャックの事になると
つい感情をあらわにすることがある。
自らが血式少女だと判明し、
ジャックと共にジェイルから脱獄する為
血式少女隊に入ることを決意する。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's good friend,
whose soft spot 
for him betrays 
her normally calm
demeanor. She joins
the Blood Maidens
in order to escape.

fields.EN:
The first Blood Maiden discovered and the unit's
first member. A bold, rough, muscle-brained older-
sister type who charges through the Jail. As its
longest-serving member, she leads the girls despite
her rough-and-ready nature.
fields.JP:
血式少女隊、一人目の少女。
最初に発見された血式少女で、
時に豪快、時に大ざっぱに監獄を
駆け巡る脳筋お姉さん。
一番長く所属しているということもあり
大ざっぱながらも少女たちを束ねる
リーダーを務めている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
An older sister
type who brazenly
traverses through
the Jail. Being the
first Blood Maiden,
she currently acts as
the unit's leader.

fields.EN:
The eldest of three rare sisters who are all Blood
Maidens. She often treats Jack sternly and scolds him.
She wants to praise how earnestly he supports the unit,
but gets flustered and cannot bring herself to say it.
fields.JP:
姉妹全員が「血式少女」という
稀有な三姉妹の長女。
長女気質故、ジャックに厳しく接したり、
叱るといったことがよくある。
血式少女隊のサポートとして、
健気に頑張るジャックを褒めたくても
なかなか言えずもじもじする時もある。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Often scolding or
pushing Jack around
despite his best
efforts. As she is
unable to genuinely
praise him, she can
be fidgety at times.

fields.EN:
The kind middle sister. She reaches out to Jack when
the Blood Maidens push him around, but her clumsiness
can produce unexpected results. Whether from low
confidence or some other cause, mirrors frighten her.
fields.JP:
誰にでも優しく接する三姉妹の次女。
血式少女たちに振り回されるジャックに
優しく手を差し伸べるものの、
持ち前のドジっ娘っぷりでかえって
斜め上の結果になってしまう時がある。
自分に自身がないのか、何かの因果か、
鏡を見ると怯える一面がある。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Always tries to
lend a gentle but
clumsy hand to 
Jack. Her fear of
mirrors may be due
having no self-
confidence.

fields.EN:
The youngest sister, with an unusual air and behavior
that often confuses Jack. Yet when he is down, she is
kind enough to reach out to him. She communicates by
nodding or shaking her head and always seems sleepy.
fields.JP:
独特な雰囲気を持つ三姉妹の末っ子。
不思議な言動の持ち主で、
ジャックを困惑させることが多い。
しかし、ジャックが落ち込んでいると、
手を差し伸べる優しさを持っている。
首を縦に振ったり、横に振ることで
意思を伝え、いつも眠そうにしている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mysterious in her
approach, but
ultimately helpful.
She conveys her
feelings through
head nods, and
always looks tired.

fields.EN:
A girl who lived in the Dorm area with the Nightmare
Hansel. Intensely curious, but very cold toward things
that do not interest her, she can make amoral remarks.
She sometimes watches the overly kind Jack with interest.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアのヘンゼルと共に
旧学生街エリアで暮らしていた少女。
知的好奇心が旺盛だが、
興味のないものにはとてもドライで
倫理観に欠けた発言をすることがある。
ジャックのことをお人好しとして
時折、興味深そうに眺めている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A girl who lived in
the Dorm with the
Nightmare, Hansel.
Naturally curious,
though sometimes
amoral. Jack's kind 
nature excites her.

fields.EN:
The youngest Blood Maiden, found in the Waterside area,
with long blond hair. Bright and energetic, she sometimes
mistakes Jack for emergency food and bites him. She is
attached to Nemurihime and likes napping on her chest.
fields.JP:
旧河川・沼エリアで発見された
長い金髪が特徴の最年少の血式少女。
元気はつらつで、ジャックの事を
非常食と勘違いして噛みつくことも。
眠り姫に懐いており、彼女の胸で眠る
のが好きらしく、一緒にお昼寝している
ところをよく目撃されている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Golden-haired, full
of energy, and
sometimes mistakes
Jack for food. She
can be found taking
naps on Sleeping
Beauty's chest.

fields.EN:
A girl who uses exaggerated refined-lady speech, yet is
a neat freak with an oddly frugal side. Despite her proud
words and manner, she is humble at heart and can fall into
negative thinking when she troubles or confuses someone.
fields.JP:
大袈裟なお嬢様言葉を発するが
綺麗好きで貧乏臭い一面を持つ少女。
色々と尊大な態度や言葉使いをするが、
根はとても謙虚な性格で、相手を
困惑させたりしてしまうと
ネガティブ思考に落ち入ることがある。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Despite her some-
times holier-than-
thou attitude, she
is actually very
modest, and takes
it to heart when
she upsets someone.

fields.EN:
An extremely lazy shut-in who avoids Blood Maiden duties.
She rides the large Bamboo One both while traveling and
fighting. Rumor says she also hides the mysterious
'Seven Tools for Slacking' in the hem of her clothes.
fields.JP:
極度の面倒くさがり屋で
血式少女としての活動をせず
部屋に引きこもるだらだら少女。
移動する時も戦う時も大きな乗り物
「バンブー１号」に乗っている。
他にも服の裾に「サボリ７つ道具」を
隠しているとかいないとか。
fields.LOCALIZED:
An amazingly lazy
girl known for always
cruising on her
special ride, Bamboo
One. She may
have some secrets
up her sleeve...

fields.EN:
A Blood Maiden found in the underground prison. She gives
off an intimidating aura, but is extremely clumsy, often
slurring words or falling over. Calling herself the Demon
King, she acts arrogantly until Alice rebukes her, after
which she grows attached to Alice.
fields.JP:
地下監獄エリアで発見された血式少女。
畏怖すべきオーラを放つものの
極度のドジっ娘であり、良く噛んだり、
コケたりする為、いまいち締まらない。
自らを魔王と名乗り、他の血式少女に
尊大な態度を取るが、アリスに一喝され
以降はアリスを慕うようになる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her struggle in
articulating ideas
disrupts the aura of
fear she attempts to
convey. She treats
everyone arrogantly
- except for Alice.

fields.EN:
Originally a Nightmare saved by Ningyohime, which caused
her to fall in love with her. She considers Ningyohime's
smile her greatest treasure.
fields.JP:
元は人魚姫に助けられたことを
キッカケに人魚姫に恋をしたナ
イトメア。人魚姫の笑顔が一番
の宝物だと思っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
A former Nightmare that
fell in love with Little Mermaid.
She considers Little Mermaid's
smile the greatest treasure
of them all.

fields.EN:
A girl accidentally killed by Akazukin after entering
Blood Skelter in the past. Because you did not give up,
she was revived and saved. She considers Tsuu's smile
her greatest treasure.
fields.JP:
過去にブラッドスケルター化した
ことで、事故で赤ずきんに殺され
てしまった少女。　あなたが諦め
なかったことで蘇り救うことがで
きた。つうの笑顔が一番の宝物だ
と思っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
A girl killed by Red
Riding Hood. Your efforts
have brought her back
to life. She considers
Otsuu's smile the greatest
treasure of them all.

fields.EN:
A Jail researcher present since Dawn's founding and its
representative. He has vast knowledge of the Jail and is
more passionate than anyone about escaping it. Akazukin,
whom he raised from infancy, affectionately calls him Father.
fields.JP:
黎明創成期からいるジェイルの研究者
であり、黎明の代表を務める男性。
ジェイルに関しての知識を豊富に持ち、
ジェイル脱獄への思いは誰よりも熱い。
赤ん坊の頃から育てられた赤ずきんは
彼のことを「お父さん」と慕っている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A researcher who
holds vast knowledge
of the Jail, and is
extremely passionate
about escaping. He
raised Red Riding
Hood from infancy.

fields.EN:
Dawn's foul-mouthed, brusque weapons craftsman. One of
the few artisans able to make the Blood Weapons used by
the Blood Maidens. He keeps an eye on Jack, who worries
about his own lack of strength.
fields.JP:
口が悪く、ぶっきらぼうで態度が悪い
黎明の武器製造士。
血式少女達が使う「血式武器」を作れる
数少ない職人。自らの力不足に悩む
ジャックのことを気にかけている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A craftsman with a
bad mouth and a
worse attitude,
though he seems to
care for Jack, who
often questions his
own usefulness.

fields.EN:
A calm and cool-headed but kind older-sister figure on
Dawn's medical team. Like a guardian to the Blood Maidens,
she hears their worries and advises them, while also
researching the Jail with the professor.
fields.JP:
冷静で冷徹ながらも
心優しい黎明の救護班のお姉さん。
血式少女達の保護者のように
悩みを聞いてアドバイスをしたり、
博士と共にジェイルについて調べるなど
多岐にわたり才能を発揮している。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cool and calm, but
also very kind-
hearted. She gives
counsel to the
Blood Maidens, and
also works closely
with the professor.

fields.EN:
A bright, energetic girl working as Haru's assistant.
She speaks in junior-style language ending in '-ssu' and
admires Haru greatly. She normally minds the store.
fields.JP:
ハルの元で製造士の助手をしている
元気で明るい少女。

fields.EN:
The protagonist, a girl serving as one of Dawn's Blood
Maidens. As a child, she and Ningyohime pledged themselves
as spouses. To become Ningyohime's 'prince,' she strives
to act princely and dignified in public, though she also
has a timid side befitting a girl her age.
fields.JP:
黎明の血式少女として活動する"少女"で
本作の主人公。幼い頃に人魚姫と夫婦
としての契りを結んでおり「人魚姫の
王子様」になるために、人前では王子
様たれと努めて貴然に振る舞っている。
年相応の少女としての気弱な一面もある。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The story's main protagonist who is
a member of Dawn and also a Blood
Maiden. She bonded with Little Mermaid
in marriage during their youth, and
holds a graceful front to become the
Little Mermaid's "Prince," but she
sometimes shows her feminine side, too.

fields.EN:
A devoted, brave girl who puts a loved one's happiness
before her own. When Otsuu proposed as a child, she blurted
out that she wanted Tsuu to become her prince. She deeply
loves Otsuu, who sincerely devotes herself to being her prince.
fields.JP:
自分の幸せよりも大切な人の幸せを
優先する一途で健気な少女。
幼い時におつうにプロポーズをされ
反射的に「王子様になってほしい」と
言ってしまう。実直に自分のために
王子様として尽くしてくれるおつう
に深い愛を持っている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A kind and brave girl who seeks the
happiness of others before her own.
Little Mermaid asked Otsuu to be her prince
when Otsuu asked for her hand in
marriage. She loves Otsuu who is trying
her best to become her true prince.

fields.EN:
Imprisoned in the Jail with Alice, he was rescued by Tsuu
and the others. After an unfortunate incident he became a
Nightmare. Though timid, he remains strong at heart, and
his personality changed little. He regrets failing to
protect Alice.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの収容者としてアリスと共に
囚われていたがつう達に助けられる。
その後不幸な出来事によりナイトメアに。
少し気弱ながらも芯の強い側面を持ち、
ナイトメアになってからもその性格は
あまり変わっていない。　アリスを
守れなかったことを悔いている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack was captured with Alice, but was
later saved by Otsuu. Unfortunately, he
later turns into a Nightmare. He may
be shy, but he holds a strong heart, and
this personality doesn't change even
as a Nightmare. He regrets not being
able to protect Alice.

fields.EN:
A Blood Maiden met in the underground cavern. She often
slurs her words or falls over, undermining her intimidating
air. She called herself the Demon King, but after gaining
the companions she longed for, she self-job-changed into
a 'Hero.'
fields.JP:
地下洞窟で出会った血式少女。
ちょくちょく言葉を噛んだり、
転んだりするためいまいち小物感が
拭いきれない。　自らを「魔王」と
名乗っていたが、憧れの「仲間」を
得たことで「勇者」へとセルフジョブ
チェンジしてしまう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A Blood Maiden found in the underground
caverns. She seems to slur often, and is quite
clumsy. She called herself a "demon king,"
but later calls herself a "hero" after gaining
new friends.

fields.EN:
A girl who lived in the Dorm area with the Nightmare Hansel.
Intensely curious, but cold toward things that do not interest
her, she can make amoral remarks. She sometimes watches
Tsuu and Ningyohime with great interest.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアのヘンゼルと共に
旧学生街エリアで暮らしていた少女。
知的好奇心が旺盛だが、
興味のないものにはとてもドライで
倫理観に欠けた発言をすることがある。
つうと人魚姫のことを時折、
興味深そうに眺めている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A girl that lived in the Dorm area with
her Nightmare brother, Hansel. She is very
nonchalant in things which do not interest
her, and often says things that are
considered societally wrong. She is sometimes
found staring at Otsuu and Little Mermaid
with great interest.

fields.EN:
The youngest Blood Maiden, found in the Waterside area,
with long blond hair. Bright and energetic, she sometimes
mistakes Ningyohime for a fish and bites her. Her innocent
behavior can soothe the other Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
旧河川・沼エリアで発見された
長い金髪が特徴の最年少の血式少女。
元気はつらつで、人魚姫の事を
魚と勘違いして噛みつくことも。
の天真爛漫な言動は時に他の
血式少女達への癒しになることも
fields.LOCALIZED:
A long, gold haired girl found at the
Waterside area. She is very bright and
lively, and can be found biting Little
Mermaid and calling her "Fishy." Her
honesty and purity often helps bring
calm and resolution to the other Blood
Maidens.

fields.EN:
She rides the large Bamboo One both while traveling and
fighting, and supposedly hides seven mysterious tools, such
as a spray bottle, in her clothes. She reacts sharply to
words like 'useless' or 'burden.'
fields.JP:
移動する時も戦う時も大きな乗り物
「バンブー１号」に乗っており、
懐には霧吹きなど謎の七つ道具を
隠しているという。　役立たずや
足手まといといった言葉に機敏に
反応する
fields.LOCALIZED:
A lazy girl that is found always riding on her
trusty device, Bamboo One. She carries with
her tools to help her look like she's doing
work. She has a tendency of reacting
to words that make her seem like a burden.

fields.EN:
The eldest of three rare sisters who are both Blood Maidens
and Hitsuka. She treasures Shirayukihime and Nemurihime and
believes she must care for them and watch over them so they
do not become unhappy.
fields.JP:
姉妹全員が「血式少女」「陽司」
という稀有な三姉妹の長女。
白雪姫と眠り姫を大事にしており、
自分が二人の面倒を見て、不幸に
ならないよう見守らなくてはいけ
ないと思っている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The oldest of the three sisters, all
who are Blood Maidens and carry the title of
"Hitsuka." She takes great care of keeping
Snow White and Sleeping Beauty safe,
and thinks she's the only one who can
protect them.

fields.EN:
The kind middle sister. She respects Oyayubihime, but when
her elder sister treats others mercilessly she instinctively
rebels, leading to fights. Because of this, she often does
not know what to say around Oyayubihime and falls silent.
fields.JP:
誰にでも優しく接する三姉妹の次女。
姉の親指姫を尊敬はしているが、
周りの人々に容赦のない態度を
取る度に思わず反抗してしまい、
喧嘩になってしまう。　そのため
普段は親指姫の前では何を話して
良いかわからず黙ってしまう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The second oldest of the three sisters.
She respects Thumbelina, but
sometimes gets into a fights with her when
she is treating others badly. This
leads to Snow White's reluctance
of speaking while Thumbelina is around.

fields.EN:
The youngest sister, with an unusual air. She works to become
worthy of being a Hitsuka, to help her sisters, and to speak
better, but it does not go as hoped. Perhaps from pushing
herself so hard, she sometimes clings to Otsuu or Ningyohime.
fields.JP:
独特な雰囲気を持つ三姉妹の末っ子。
陽司にふさわしい人物になろうと、
姉たちを少しでも助けようと、
うまく言葉を話せるよう努力しているが
思うようにはいっていない様子
必死に頑張ろうとしている反動か
時々おつうや人魚姫に甘えてくる
fields.LOCALIZED:
The youngest of the three sisters. She
tries her best to talk to help others, but
she can't seem to get herself to
communicate. Her efforts often stress
her to the extent that she fawns on
Otsuu and Little Mermaid.

fields.EN:
A girl whose growth stopped after entering Blood Skelter.
She speaks and acts haughtily, but is actually very negative
and can fall into pessimistic thinking. Her younger companion
Rapunzel is always cheering her up.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化したことで、
成長が止まってしまった少女。
色々と尊大な態度や言葉使いをするが、
実はとても後ろ向きな性格で、
ネガティブ思考に落ち入ることがある。
年下のラプンツェルにいつも元気を
もらっている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A girl who stopped aging because of
Blood Skelter. She speaks with grace
and pride, but she's actually very
pessimistic, and is often found down
on herself. She is also often found
getting a lot of encouragement
from Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
The first Blood Maiden discovered. Bold, rough, and sometimes
insensitive, she keeps everyone together. Having served the
longest since Dawn's early days, she was the girls' leader
despite her rough-and-ready nature.
fields.JP:
血式少女隊、一人目の少女。
最初に発見された血式少女で、
時に豪快、時に豪快に、時に
無神経に皆を束ねている。
黎明時代は一番長く所属している
ということもあり大ざっぱながらも
少女たちを束ねるリーダーであった
fields.LOCALIZED:
The first Blood Maiden of Dawn. She
leads everyone with bravado and with
unfettered boldness. Despite being a bit
on the rough side, her extensive
experience at Dawn has made her the
leader of the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Jack's childhood friend. Serious and level-headed, she can
become emotional when it comes to Jack. Even after he becomes
a Nightmare, she continues to treat him with affection.
fields.JP:
ジャックと幼馴染の少女。
物事を冷静に見る真面目な性格だが、
幼馴染のジャックの事になると
つい感情をあらわにすることがある。
ジャックがナイトメアになっても、
親愛を持って接している。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's long time friend. She is very
calm and analytical, but gets emotional
when involving Jack. She loves Jack,
even after he turned into a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
A young man encountered in the underground cavern. He looks
a little rough, but is dependable and caring. He becomes the
first precious companion for Otsuu and Ningyohime after they
are separated from everyone and left anxious and alone.
fields.JP:
地下洞窟で遭遇した少年。
目つきや柄が少し悪そうだが
仲間思いのしっかり者。
皆とはぐれて心細いおつうや
人魚姫たちにできた初めの大事な仲間
fields.LOCALIZED:
A young man found at the underground
cavern. He doesn't look approachable,
but is actually very kind and is
surprisingly responsible. He accompanies
Otsuu and Little Mermaid, helping them
through the ordeal.

fields.JP:
その場にいるだけで周囲が
明るくなるような、人々を
照らし元気にしてくれる力がある。
人間達はおろかハーメルンの
下僕のメルヒェンまで癒している。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A young girl who seems to bring cheer
wherever and whenever she's
around. She even seems to bring cheer
to Hameln's minions.

fields.EN:
A calm, composed young man with intelligence and adaptability.
When trouble arises, he calculates endlessly. He is quite poor
at exercise. His childhood friend Kaede treats him like a child.
fields.JP:
冷静沈着で応用力のある頭の良さがあり、
困った時はひたすら計算。
ただ運動は大分苦手である。
カエデとは幼馴染で子ども
扱いされている
fields.LOCALIZED:
A silent and intelligent young man
that relies on logic instead of brute
force and manual labor. He isn't
athletic, and is often found being teased
by his long time friend, Kaede.

fields.EN:
A tomboyish, quick-tempered big-sister type who supports the
Blood Maidens from the shadows. She watches over Itsuki with
all her strength—in a very physical sense.
fields.JP:
男勝りで喧嘩っ早いがアネゴ肌な
性格で、影ながら血式少女達を
支えている。　イツキのことを
物理的に力いっぱい見守っている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's the big sister among the group,
and can get angry quickly, but she's
always there to support the Blood
Maidens. She takes care of Itsuki to the
best that she can possible, mostly
in physical terms.

fields.EN:
An eccentric mechanic whose first-person pronoun changes with
his mood: ore, boku, watashi, washi, oira, sessha... He uses
whatever pronoun comes to mind. He is one of the few people
capable of handling Blood Weapons.
fields.JP:
風変わりなメカニックマン
その時の気分で一人称が変わる。
俺・僕・私・ワシ・おいら・拙者……
思いつく限りの一人称を適当に使う。
数少ない血式武器を扱える人物
fields.LOCALIZED:
A unique mechanic. He seems to have a
wide variety of speech styles that he mixes
every so often. He is also one of the
very few who is in the know of
Blood Weapons.

fields.EN:
A Nightmare from the old Dorm area whom Gretel looks up to as
her brother. Hansel likewise adores Gretel as his little sister
and considers her precious family. He is also Nightmare Jack's
dear friend.
fields.JP:
グレーテルが兄と慕っている
元学生街エリアのナイトメア。
ヘンゼルもグレーテルを妹と慕っており、
大事な家族の一人だと思っている
ナイトメア・ジャックの大事な友達
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel's brother and Nightmare who lived
in the Dorm area. Hansel treats Gretel
as his beloved sister, and also sees
Nightmare Jack as a special friend.

fields.EN:
A mysterious, bright girl who wanders the prison as a traveling
merchant. She speaks in junior-style language ending in '-ssu'
and continues roaming the prison today.
fields.JP:
独房エリアで放浪商人をしている、
正体不明の元気で明るい少女。
語尾に「っす」と後輩言葉で喋り、
今日も独房エリアを放浪している。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A young and bright girl traveling the
prison areas as a wandering merchant.
She is very approachable and
full of energy, always speaking to
everyone casually.

fields.EN:
Leader of the Order of the Sun, preaching the prophecy:
'One day the Sun God will burn the canopy, and the day will
come when people can leave the prison.' Followers call her
Oohime; her real name is Michiru. Her mysterious words confuse
people, yet carry an air of divinity.
fields.JP:
「いつか太陽の神が天幕を焼き、
　監獄の外へと出られる日が来る」
という予言を提唱するタイヨウの教祖。
「大陽女（おおひめ）」という名で信者
からは呼ばれている。本名はミチル。
不思議な発言が多く、人々を翻弄するが、
その言葉には神々しさが漂っている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A religious leader of the Order who 
speaks with a shroud of mystery.
Her confusing words possess an 
odd sort of divinity.

fields.EN:
The mysterious being called the King of Nightmares. Professor
Toojima met him once in the past, and he has reportedly not
been seen since.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアの王と呼ばれている、
全てが謎に包まれている生命体。
過去に一度、十島博士が会ったきり、
その姿は目撃されていないという。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The "King of Nightmares." A being
of unknown origin. Snark met with
Professor Tohjima long ago, but has not
been seen since.

fields.EN:
A Jail researcher present since Dawn's founding and its
representative. He has vast knowledge of the Jail and is more
passionate than anyone about escaping it. Akazukin, whom he
raised from infancy, affectionately calls him Father.
fields.JP:
黎明創成期からいるジェイルの研究者
であり、黎明の代表を務める男性。
ジェイルに関しての知識を豊富に持ち、
ジェイル脱獄への思いは誰よりも熱い。
赤ん坊の頃から育てられた赤ずきんは
彼のことを「お父さん」と慕っている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A researcher who holds vast knowledge
of the Jail, and is extremely passionate
about escaping. He raised Red Riding
Hood from infancy.

fields.EN:
Dawn's foul-mouthed, brusque weapons craftsman. Reliable when
it matters. He was killed in the attack by a mysterious Nightmare.
fields.JP:
口が悪く、ぶっきらぼうで態度が悪い
黎明の武器製造士。
いざという時は頼りになる。
謎のナイトメアの襲撃により命を落とす。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A craftsman with a bad mouth and a
worse attitude, though he seems to
care for Jack, who often questions his
own usefulness. He was killed by
the mysterious Nightmare that
attacked Dawn.

fields.EN:
A woman who shows talent in many areas: like a guardian, she
hears the Blood Maidens' worries and advises them, and researches
the Jail with the professor. She was killed in the attack by a
mysterious Nightmare.
fields.JP:
血式少女達の保護者のように
悩みを聞いてアドバイスをしたり、
博士と共にジェイルについて調べるなど
多岐にわたり才能を発揮している女性。
謎のナイトメアの襲撃により命を落とす。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cool and calm, but also very kind-
hearted. She gives counsel to the
Blood Maidens, and also works closely
with the professor. She was killed by
the mysterious Nightmare that
attacked Dawn.

fields.EN:
The gatekeeper guarding the Liberated District entrance. His
parents were killed by Marchens, leaving him with a deep hatred
of them. He was killed in the attack by a mysterious Nightmare.
fields.JP:
解放地区の入り口を守っている門番。
両親をメルヒェンに殺されており、
メルヒェンに対して強い憎しみを持つ
謎のナイトメアの襲撃により命を落とす
fields.LOCALIZED:
The guard at the entrance to the
Liberated District. Despite being a
normal human, he's strong enough to
hold off Marchens. He was killed by
the mysterious Nightmare that
attacked Dawn.
